Health Functional FoodLutein 20mgVitamin A 800μgVitamin B2 1.4mgVitamin C 30mgSelenium 55μgZinc 8.5mgOnce a day

루테인20Lutein · Vitamin A · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin C · Selenium · Zinc

Made by (주)유니쎌팜 · Once a day · 1 capsule

This product combines 20mg of Lutein, 800μg of Vitamin A, 1.4mg of Vitamin B2, 30mg of Vitamin C, 55μg of Selenium, 8.5mg of Zinc as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 capsule): 20mg Lutein, 800μg Vitamin A, 1.4mg Vitamin B2, 30mg Vitamin C, 55μg Selenium, 8.5mg Zinc
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by (주)유니쎌팜

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Lutein
    • May help with maintaining macular pigment density (which can decline with age) for eye health
  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Selenium
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 capsule per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Lutein labelled (20mg / 500mg), 80~120%
Vitamin A labelled (800μg / 500mg), 80~150%
Vitamin B2 labelled (1.4mg / 500mg), 80~180%
Vitamin C labelled (30mg / 500mg), 80~150%
Selenium labelled (55μg / 500mg), 80~150%
Zinc labelled (8.5mg / 500mg), 80~150%
Appearance 이미, 이취가 없고 고유의 향미가 있는 적갈색의 내용물을 함유한 검정색의 연질캡슐
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 24개월
Storage 고온다습한 곳에 두시면 젤라틴 피막이 변형 될 수 있으므로 반드시 직사광선과 습기를 피하여 실온에 보관 하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Lutein · Vitamin A · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin C · Selenium · Zinc together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product
